verdict.rationale: Casium publishes a public visa-guide library reviewed by attorneys. It includes a startup-relevant International Entrepreneur Parole article covering eligibility criteria and the application process, an EB-1A criteria breakdown, and O-1A and EB-2 NIW explainers. Nothing in the evidence confirms the guides are ungated, and none of it shows real case examples. Missing for 10: real worked examples or case studies, explicit confirmation the guides are free and not gated behind sign-up, evidence of depth across startup-specific visa pathways, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider publishes substantial free guides on startup visas — criteria breakdowns, process explainers, real examples — open to anyone, not gated lead bait
